text:
ben.partnerships: Heads-up from vendor sync: NVIDIA shared a staggered H200 roll (EMEA then US) and an earlier-than-expected B200 availability in some clouds. AMD MI300 forecast slipped ~3 weeks. Gaudi team reported a minor kernel ABI change. We need to coordinate SKU exposure, SI test windows, and an announcement tempo.

nina.eng: For the Gaudi ABI change, we need to freeze CI images for a short window. I'll propose image tags with a '-gaudi-patch' suffix so SI teams can opt in.

oscar.prod: Proposal: two-batch announcement: batch1 = H200 + B200 + Gaudi; batch2 = MI300. Batch1 to partners as early-access, soft marketplace listing two days later, public announce + marketplace open after marketing signoff.

 tina.marketing: Sounds good. Request clear embargo windows per partner and a mandatory 72h runway for press quote approvals. Also, require a final go/no-go 48h before public listing.

 sam.si: SI integration ask: can we get a reproducible perf harness (docker image + sample dataset) and a driver compatibility matrix? That reduces on-prem surprises.

 chip.hw-ops: We'll produce the compatibility matrix but need partner SKU expectations. Draft below (subject to vendor confirmations):
```
- nvidia-h200-64g: workload-rt-1 -> eu-central-1, us-west-2
- nvidia-b200-80g: workload-batch-1 -> us-east-1, ap-southeast-1
- samba-gaudi-v2: workload-gaudi -> eu-central-1
- amd-mi300-128g: workload-mi -> us-west-2 (target)
```
Note MI300 region tentative.

 nina.eng: For rollout, suggest canary policy: 10% traffic to new SKU for 4h then ramp if no errors. Also pre-deploy runtime patch to canary nodes only.

 oscar.prod: We'll need a rollback checklist (marketplace toggle off, SI partner notification template, routing reverts). Can someone add to the runbook?

 ben.partnerships: Action list: 1) chip: finalize SKU map + firmware table by Fri. 2) nina: publish GAUDI image tag naming and CI freeze window. 3) sam: collect SI partner image requirements. 4) tina: draft press embargo schedule and go/no-go cadence.

 announce-bot: Reminder: Prep channel doc "HW Launch Runbook" updated. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/hw-launch-runbook

 tina.marketing: I'll set up a shared folder for press assets and partner quotes. Please drop quotes 72h prior.

 ben.partnerships: If no objections, we'll discuss rollout percentages and exact dates in Monday's sync. :rocket:
